verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official Model Context Protocol integration. Developers can build their own agent or bot as a custom MCP client against a Capacities space ([capacities-docs-17]), and Chat Connectors link ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Le Chat to the space ([capacities-docs-3]). A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists ([capacities-probe-3]). Missing for 10: detail on which tools and resources the MCP server exposes, MCP-specific setup and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
